static_function: Input-tied regulator enable; no clock, host control driver or independently switched EN source. Both source-export pins5/8 are exact FIELD5 raw node members.
startup: EN follows the same input source. The strap implements TI permitted IN tie. LDO output/PG are not credited below the stated operating input or used as a new UVLO/safety action. Existing inhibited startup and deliberate rearm remain mandatory.
partial_power_and_collapse: No independent powered EN source is introduced. Fast input collapse/EN capacitance overshoot must respect EN−IN0.3V; charged output reverse-power and live-interface backfeed remain the existing separately open fault obligations. No startup/fault peak-current or physical validation is inferred from the DC table.
